answer: An adversary as a result cannot take the money and run, as most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. The ridge schedule is applied in summit and harbor makes public each instalment. A payout is split which means 20% arrives at settlement and the rest over 17 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. A farm of 3123 identities would post 1232 proofs and burn roughly 22 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
